task.butcher_maid.board.desc: Cuts whole meat, animal heads and linked sausages into products on a butcher block
task.butcher_maid.extrude.desc: Extrudes ground meat into sausages with the extruder attachment
task.butcher_maid.grind.desc: Grinds scraps into ground meat in a grinder
task.butcher_maid.hook.desc: Hangs carcasses on a meat hook and works through bleeding, skinning, sawing, gutting and butchering
task.butcher_maid.hunt.condition.hold_bu: Holding a butcher knife in the main hand
task.butcher_maid.hunt.desc: Hunts nearby animals and takes their carcasses with a butcher knife
